info.title: Installment Payment Engine API
info.description: Reusable installment payment engine for the Ghanaian / West African market. Request bodies are validated with Zod inside the domain services. Most endpoints require a Bearer access token from POST /auth/login or the customer OTP flow; admin endpoints additionally require RBAC permissions.
